label: Amazon Web Services
description: AWS access keys: long-term keys (AKIA), temporary credentials (ASIA), and the standard variable names.

signals.reason: A long-term access key (AKIA) works until the owner deletes it. It has the permissions of its IAM user.
Temporary credentials (ASIA) expire after some hours. They have the permissions of their role.
The variable name is a standard AWS credential variable.
The item name or a label names AWS.
A host of the item is an AWS host (amazonaws.com).
